title: Elite Number One versus Number Two and Give-a-Damn Jones
summary: Number One was farther down State Street; Tenan Jones's brother got his nickname after telling a cop he did not give a damn.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition

blocks.x: Yes. We haven't really -- well, we were talking about the Elite Number One and the Number Two.
What was the difference between those two?

The Elite Number One was way downtown -- I mean, not way downtown. It was down around a hundred and -- it was further down on State Street than Elite Number Two. I don't know why they called it Elite Number Two. I don't know why Mr. Jones, Tenan Jones, named it --

Maybe so. Maybe so. But I know he had a brother named Give-a-Damm Jones, you know, and he was -- yeah, he was -- I don't know. The cop told him something, and he told him he didn't give a damn. I don't know what it was, but that's the story about Give-a-Damn. But anyhow, now we're going from the De Luxe, aren't we?
